• (03:13) - Brian Chesky Goes on the Nice List

  • (43:53) - The Great Hobby Debate
  • (57:42) - Dan Goldenberg discusses his journey from Navy captain and corporate executive to president of the Call of Duty Endowment. He explains how the organization uses rigorous, results-driven philanthropy to help veterans secure high-quality civilian jobs and explores how AI could enable employment counselors to support more veterans effectively.
  • (01:22:32) - Darren Farber discusses his experience as a former Department of Defense weapons buyer and current defense-focused private equity investor at Albion River. He explains his strategy of acquiring critical weapons-component manufacturers, using automation to strengthen production, and applying battlefield lessons to defense manufacturing while assessing AI, drones, supply chains, and venture capital’s growing role in the industry.
  • (01:45:17) - Walter Goodwin, founder and CEO of AI chip company Fractile, discusses its $720 million funding round and plans to expand its global team, secure manufacturing capacity, and accelerate chip production. He explains Fractile’s memory-stacking architecture, which aims to deliver dramatically higher bandwidth and faster AI model performance, while highlighting its potential role in cybersecurity and AI safety.
